findings.highlight: ran through the jaws of death many times and survived.
findings.evidenceJa: 死地を豹のように駆け抜け
findings.governingReading: His repeated survival is pictured as running through danger like a panther.

findings.highlight: This is the fifth Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争は今回で五回目
findings.governingReading: The fifth instance is the war, separate from its summoning sites.
findings.explanation: The fifth Grail War becomes the fifth Grail.

findings.highlight: it was summoned at the church in the third war. The fourth one was summoned in some plain somewhere.
findings.evidenceJa: 三回目の召喚場所は教会だったらしい。四回目はどこぞの平地だったそうだ
findings.governingReading: らしい and そうだ explicitly mark the third and fourth sites as received information.
findings.explanation: Reported earlier summoning sites become unqualified assertions.
